range.boundary: Policy.act only; excludes engine transitions, imports and initialization.

precision.boundary: Policy.act only; excludes engine transitions, imports and initialization.

policy_replay_selection: pairs 0 and 64 in every seed, opponent and arm, both seats; selected independently of outcomes
interval_method: Student-t paired-deal intervals within each fixed opponent; equal-weight Welch aggregate
interpretation: Fixed synthetic-opponent screen; approximate unadjusted secondary intervals. No human-profitability or expert-opponent claim. No default promotion.

plan.purpose: predeclared comparison of opt-in equity precision versus unchanged range policy
plan.primary_endpoint: equal-opponent mean candidate-minus-baseline net BB/100 on matched two-seat deck pairs
plan.uncertainty: Student-t paired-deal intervals within each fixed opponent; equal-weight Welch aggregate
plan.promotion: do not replace existing default from this screen; stronger external test and separate confirmation required
plan.opponent_limit: all local opponents are heuristics, not verified expert-level agents
plan.source_freeze: copy to source/ after candidate regression and baseline reproducibility checks pass

promotion: not promoted: primary interval includes zero
